a.xlink:title: Lists the units of the bundled cases in a dialog and adds the one the user chooses with addLibraryUni...
True when a scene is loaded.
Whether a composition with only the chosen unit is added as well. True until the tick box is cleared.
The message and the fix of firstDiagnostic, for a dialog; empty without a diagnostic.
True when a diagnostic has severity Error.
The selected unit; null while a heading or nothing is selected.

The train unit with this id, or null. The pointer points into the model.
Selects the unit with this id. False when there is none.
A message that the user acknowledges. A scripted run has no user to do that, so nothing is shown then...
A message for the status line of the window, shown for timeoutMs milliseconds.
Reads rolling_stock.json: the train units and the compositions.
The first error among the diagnostics, else the first diagnostic, else null.
